collection.description: A child who got lost in the woods says Biggles pointed the way home.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A child who got lost in the woods claims 'Biggles' pointed toward home. Their description changes whenever someone asks.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Adults thank the child for telling them and improve trail markers.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The child remembers a birdcall and a pale figure, but cannot say more.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The village neither mocks nor declares it true; the child keeps a private drawing.
